strings.site.tagline: Every loop is a record waiting to happen.
strings.site.description: Turn an 8-bar loop into a finished, arranged record in the style of any artist, producer or genre — performed live in your DAW, then dragged out as audio stems or as a MIDI song template. A CLAP, VST3 and AU plugin, a standalone app and a web app for Windows, macOS and Linux — free today, offline and 100% AI-free.
